NAME = "spread-option"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Leverages spread-vs-level: volatile POIs (large fitted uniform width) have
    # compounding upside from drift, so weight their current profit more than
    # stable POIs. Stable high-profit POIs are harvested as-is.
    p = np.asarray(state.profit, dtype=float)
    M, n = p.shape
    if M > 1:
        dp = np.abs(np.diff(p, axis=0))
        w = 2.0 * dp.mean(axis=0)          # ~uniform half-width proxy per POI
    else:
        w = np.full(n, 0.05)
    w = np.where(np.isfinite(w) & (w > 1e-4), w, 0.05)
    leverage = 1.0 + 0.5 * np.clip(w, 0.0, 0.5)
    return (p * leverage) * region_mask[None, :].astype(float)

NAME = "prob-activation"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Nodes one drift-step from activation: estimate P(next profit > threshold)
    # under uniform noise of estimated half-width; prioritise POIs about to
    # cross (catch them at activation, before any mean-reversion pull), while
    # clearly-good POIs are harvested directly.
    p = np.asarray(state.profit, dtype=float)
    M, n = p.shape
    if M > 1:
        dp = np.abs(np.diff(p, axis=0))
        w = 2.0 * dp.mean(axis=0)
    else:
        w = np.full(n, 0.05)
    w = np.clip(np.where(np.isfinite(w) & (w > 1e-4), w, 0.05), 0.01, 0.5)
    thr = np.quantile(p, 0.9, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # (1, n) activation level
    prob = np.clip((p + w[None, :] - thr) / (2.0 * w[None, :]), 0.0, 1.0)
    return (p + 0.3 * prob) * region_mask[None, :].astype(float)

NAME = "trend-rider"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Exploits a fitted per-POI linear day-trend in the drift mean (piecewise /
    # evolving-spread hypotheses): a POI with positive slope is projected to be
    # worth more later, so project profit forward over the remaining episode
    # and discount only weakly, deferring climbs and harvesting plateaus.
    p = np.asarray(state.profit, dtype=float)
    M, n = p.shape
    if M > 1:
        t = np.arange(M, dtype=float)[:, None]
        tc = t - t.mean()
        denom = max((tc ** 2).sum(), 1e-9)
        slope = ((p - p.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)) * tc).sum(axis=0) / denom
        slope = np.clip(np.nan_to_num(slope), -0.2, 0.2)
    else:
        slope = np.zeros(n)
    t_now = float(np.max(np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(state.t, dtype=float))))
    horizon = max(env.T - t_now, 0.0)
    proj = p + 0.5 * slope[None, :] * horizon
    return proj * region_mask[None, :].astype(float)

NAME = "shrink-harvest"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H7: observed profit = regional mean + iid noise (std ~0.029).
    # Harvest reacts to noise; shrink observations toward the regional
    # drift mean to recover the true profit surface before scoring.
    std = 0.0288
    b = np.array([0.0061, -0.0003, -0.0155, 0.0159])
    slope = 0.0002
    reg = np.argmax(region_mask) if region_mask.dtype == bool else 0
    # region index per POI
    idx = np.where(region_mask, 1, 0)
    base = b  # fallback single-region
    mu0 = float(np.mean(state.profit))  # rough level
    # posterior weight: with one noisy observation and prior centered on
    # regional mean, effective shrink depends on noise vs prior spread
    lam = 0.75  # trust observed profit, trim 25% noise
    shrunk = lam * state.profit + (1.0 - lam) * (state.profit.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    # daily drift trend: profits decay/increase with slope*t; visiting later
    # captures the trend-adjusted value
    trend = slope * state.t
    val = shrunk + trend
    # slight preference for high raw profit to keep greedy strength
    val = val + 0.25 * state.profit
    return val

NAME = "option-chain"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Trade spread against nodes one step from activation: value a POI by
    # its own profit plus the best unvisited neighbour it unlocks, so the
    # greedy route chains through clusters instead of criss-crossing.
    d = env.dist
    unvis = (~state.visited).astype(float)
    # best unvisited neighbour value within a short hop
    nb = state.profit * unvis
    # distance kernel: neighbours within radius get credit
    W = np.exp(-d / (d[d > 0].min() + 1e-9))
    unlock = (W @ nb.T).T  # (M, n) accumulated neighbour value
    # avoid double counting self
    self_val = state.profit * unvis
    gamma = 0.35
    val = self_val + gamma * unlock
    # never visit already-visited nodes
    val = np.where(state.visited, -1e9, val)
    return val

NAME = "edge-harvest"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Harvest peaks on high profit; sweep on coverage. Exploit nodes that
    # are drifting *out* of reach: under Gaussian drift with daily trend,
    # marginal POIs (just above activation) lose value fastest, so take
    # them now and leave safely-below-activation ones for later.
    tau = float(np.median(state.profit))
    std = 0.0288
    z = (state.profit - tau) / std
    # urgency: how close the node is to the decision edge from above
    urgency = np.exp(-0.5 * np.clip(z, 0.0, None) ** 2)
    val = state.profit + 0.9 * std * urgency * (~state.visited)
    # distance shaping: mild pull toward current position (cheap detours first)
    cur = state.current
    dc = env.dist[cur]  # (M, n)
    val = val - 0.02 * dc
    val = np.where(state.visited, -1e9, val)
    return val

NAME = "drift-follower"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Ride regional/node momentum: nodes whose profit is drifting up are worth
    # more over the remaining horizon than their current snapshot profit.
    t = float(state.t)
    rem = max(env.T - t, 0.0)
    denom = max(t - 1.0, 1.0)
    drift = (state.profit - env.initial_profit[None, :]) / denom
    drift = np.clip(drift, -0.05, 0.05)
    un = (~state.visited) & region_mask[None, :]
    cnt = np.maximum(un.sum(-1), 1)
    rmean = (drift * un).sum(-1) / cnt  # regional drift estimate (H7 b_region + slope*t)
    blend = 0.4 * drift + 0.6 * np.broadcast_to(rmean[:, None], drift.shape)
    val = state.profit + 10.0 * (rem + 1.0) * blend
    return np.where(state.visited, -1e6, val)

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Opposite lever: bank stagnating nodes today, let fast-rising nodes ripen
    # (they are worth more later, and budget spent on them now is wasted spread).
    t = float(state.t)
    rem = max(env.T - t, 0.0)
    denom = max(t - 1.0, 1.0)
    drift = (state.profit - env.initial_profit[None, :]) / denom
    drift = np.clip(drift, -0.05, 0.05)
    un = (~state.visited) & region_mask[None, :]
    cnt = np.maximum(un.sum(-1), 1)
    rmean = (drift * un).sum(-1) / cnt
    horizon = (rem + 1.0)
    val = state.profit - 8.0 * horizon * drift - 4.0 * horizon * rmean[:, None]
    return np.where(state.visited, -1e6, val)

NAME = "cluster-option"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Option value of neighbourhood: taking a node whose unvisited neighbours are
    # rich keeps future harvests cheap to reach; harvest's flat profit ranking
    # ignores this travel/option structure entirely.
    n = env.dist.shape[0]
    t = float(state.t)
    rem = max(env.T - t, 1.0)
    p = np.where(state.visited, 0.0, state.profit)
    d = env.dist[None, :, :]
    w = np.exp(-d / 6.0) * (~state.visited)[:, None, :]
    idx = np.arange(n)
    w[:, idx, idx] = 0.0
    opt = (w * p[:, None, :]).sum(-1) / np.maximum(w.sum(-1), 1e-9)
    val = p + 0.5 * opt * (rem / max(float(env.T), 1.0))
    return np.where(state.visited, -1e6, val)

NAME = "risk-damped-harvest"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H1-aware: near today's cluster the profit surprise band is wider
    # (near_width), so discount candidate value in proportion to that extra
    # spread instead of harvesting raw profit like `harvest` does.
    d = env.dist[state.current, :]                       # (M, n)
    near = (d < 1.5) & region_mask[None, :]
    w = np.where(near, 0.0316, 0.0293)
    # risk adjustment: value falls quadratically with the noise half-width
    # (diminishing/effectively smaller realized visits under wide bands)
    adj = state.profit - 18.0 * w * (1.0 + state.profit)
    adj = np.where(state.visited, -1e9, adj)
    return adj

NAME = "crowd-drift-follower"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H2-aware: drift mean rises with past visits up to a plateau
    # (slope 0.002, sat 3.0). Use the expected drifted profit rather than the
    # stale state.profit `harvest` relies on.
    crowd = np.zeros_like(state.profit)
    if state.visited.any():
        # proxy for accumulated visits: normalized visit indicator mass
        crowd = state.visited.astype(np.float64) * np.minimum(state.t / 3.0, 1.0)
    eff = np.minimum(crowd / 3.0, 1.0)
    expected = state.profit + 0.002 * eff
    if state.t == 1:
        expected = expected - 0.005
    expected = np.where(state.visited, -1e9, expected)
    return np.where(region_mask[None, :], expected, -1e9)

NAME = "cold-start-frontloader"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H2 cold start: on day 1 every candidate drifts down by `cold`, so high
    # base profit is worth less today and food is cheap — prioritize locking
    # high-tail POIs early (max attainable under the uniform band) and leave
    # mediocre ones for later drift-free days. Opposite ordering pressure to
    # `harvest`, which is flat across days.
    w = 0.03
    upper = state.profit + w          # best case under uniform noise
    today_weight = 1.0 - 0.005 / (w + 1e-9)   # day-1 cold-start haircut factor
    val = state.profit + (state.t == 1) * (upper - state.profit) * 0.5
    val = val * np.where(state.t == 1, today_weight, 1.0)
    val = np.where(state.visited | ~region_mask[None, :], -1e9, val)
    return val

NAME = "near-band-variance-farmer"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H1 exploit: noise width is larger inside the near-band around today's
    # current location. Greedy selection keeps E[max(profit + U[-w/2,w/2])]
    # which is increasing in w, so prioritising nodes inside the wide band
    # collects the extra spread while keeping profit in the tie-break.
    profit = state.profit
    dist_cur = env.dist[state.current, :]            # (M, n) distance to today's current node
    near = (dist_cur < 1.5) & (dist_cur > 0.0) & region_mask[None, :]
    # band bonus large enough to reorganise the top of the ranking,
    # then profit decides within the band; vanished nodes (profit<=0) excluded.
    alive = profit > 0
    bonus = 0.12 * (near & alive)
    out = profit + bonus
    return np.where(alive, out, -np.inf)

NAME = "crowd-plateau-replay"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # H2 exploit: mean drift rises linearly in cumulative visits up to a
    # plateau at sat=3. Nodes that have already accumulated visits carry a
    # positive expected offset; profit-greedy ignores it. Proxy crowd by the
    # number of prior visits, saturating at 3, and add the plateau response
    # scaled up so it can reorganise the top of the ranking.
    profit = state.profit
    visits = state.visited[:, :state.profit.shape[1]].sum(axis=0) if state.visited.shape[0] != state.profit.shape[0] else state.visited.sum(axis=0)
    eff = np.minimum(visits / 3.0, 1.0)[None, :]
    replay_bonus = 0.25 * eff
    alive = profit > 0
    out = profit + replay_bonus
    out = np.where(alive, out, -np.inf)
    # cheap centrality nudge: nodes close to other hot nodes accumulate
    # crowd faster tomorrow, breaking symmetric ties toward hub-adjacent nodes.
    heat = np.exp(-0.5 * env.dist) @ np.maximum(env.initial_profit, 0.0)
    heat = heat / (np.max(heat) + 1e-9)
    out = out + 0.01 * heat[None, :]
    return out

candidates.name: llm-tie-flat-activation-save
candidates.source:
NAME = "tie-flat-activation-saver"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    # Spread-vs-activation trade: among nodes already at the top of the
    # profit ranking, compress differences so the uniform noise (present in
    # every drift hypothesis) breaks the tie and hands us the max of several
    # near-equal realised values, instead of locking in one node now and
    # leaving the "one step from activation" nodes unresolved.
    profit = state.profit
    alive = profit > 0
    flat = np.where(alive, profit, -np.inf)
    top = np.nanmax(np.where(alive, flat, np.nan), axis=1, keepdims=True)
    top = np.nan_to_num(top, nan=0.0)
    # nodes within a small margin of the daily best become near-ties;
    # below the margin, keep raw ordering so selection still progresses.
    near_top = (flat >= top - 0.05) & alive
    flat = np.where(near_top, top - 0.5 * near_top.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) * 0.0
                    + (top - 1e-4), flat)
    # slight recency discount: avoid exact repeats of yesterday's pick set
    # so the tie-breaking noise is spread over fresh candidates too.
    visited_penalty = 0.005 * state.visited[:, :state.profit.shape[1]].sum(axis=0)[None, :]
    flat = flat - visited_penalty
    return np.where(alive, flat, -np.inf)

NAME = "risk-shaded"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    p = np.maximum(state.profit, 0.0)
    W = np.exp(-env.dist / 0.35)
    crowd = state.visited.astype(float) @ W          # past-visit crowding (M, n)
    # today's-route self-exposure proxy: proximity to other high-value candidates
    thr = np.quantile(p, 0.75, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    cand = (p >= thr).astype(float) * region_mask[None, :]
    route_pen = cand @ W                              # (M, n): crowding created *this* visit
    risk = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.5 * np.minimum(crowd, 5.0)) # H6: convex cost + widened noise near crowd
    val = p * risk - 0.05 * np.minimum(route_pen, 6.0)
    return val * region_mask[None, :]

NAME = "decay-net-predict"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    M, n = state.profit.shape
    dpos = env.dist[env.dist > 0]
    sigma = max(np.percentile(dpos, 30), 1e-3)
    K = np.exp(-env.dist / sigma)
    K = 0.5 * (K + K.T)
    tvals = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(state.t, float), (M,))[:, None]
    decay = np.exp(-(tvals - 1.0) / 2.0)               # H0-style recovery, tau~2
    V = state.visited.astype(float)
    past = V @ K                                        # (M, n) past exposure
    drift = 0.05 * past * decay
    pred = state.profit - drift                          # predicted net profit today
    # externality: visiting i spoils kernel neighbours for several future days
    w = np.maximum(pred, 0.0)
    ext = 0.05 * 0.7 * (w @ K)
    s = pred - 0.5 * ext
    # one-step deferral: nodes whose drawdown eats most of their value right now
    # are pushed hard below clean nodes instead of being marginally picked
    gross = np.maximum(state.profit, 1e-6)
    s = np.where(drift > 0.6 * gross + 0.02, s - 5.0, s)
    s = s + 1e-4 * np.sin(np.arange(n) * 12.9898)       # tie-break without id bias
    s[..., ~region_mask] = -1e6
    return s

NAME = "ramp-frontload"

def score(env, state, region_mask):
    M, n = state.profit.shape
    dpos = env.dist[env.dist > 0]
    sigma = max(np.percentile(dpos, 30), 1e-3)
    dnorm = max(np.percentile(dpos, 50), 1e-3)
    K = np.exp(-env.dist / sigma)
    K = 0.5 * (K + K.T)
    tvals = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(state.t, float), (M,))[:, None]
    ramp = 1.0 - np.exp(-(tvals - 1.0) / 2.0)           # H2: crowding ramps in, day1 near-free
    tfrac = np.clip((tvals - 1.0) / max(env.T - 1, 1), 0.0, 1.0)
    V = state.visited.astype(float)
    past = np.minimum(V @ K, 3.0)
    dc = env.dist[np.asarray(state.current, int), :] / dnorm
    # early: raw profit + short hops (depletion inactive); late: strong crowding penalty
    s = state.profit - 0.03 * dc - tfrac * 0.08 * past - 0.02 * dc
    # bank value: nodes adjacent to past visits will be depressed later, grab them now
    s = s + (1.0 - ramp) * 0.03 * past * np.maximum(state.profit, 0.0)
    s = s + 1e-4 * np.sin(np.arange(n) * 4.7213)
    s[..., ~region_mask] = -1e6
    return s
